substeps.caption: Power and network for the line, everything else drawn faint: one ladder tray overhead at 2.8 m, behind the machines and round the back of the VLM, with a drop to each machine.
Left: the glovebox (rating not found) and the rePowder atomizer, which needs 400 V three-phase and 230 V on 32 A plugs, its optimizer drawing up to about 60 A (the install call).

The VLM: its 208 V three-phase supply (#53) into the back, and the dock circuits up and over the top into the two risers. A PoE+ switch on its side feeds the risers and the bay camera; N2 and chilled water come from units standing beside it.
Right: the Aconity MIDI (supply not found), the two Instrons and the wire EDM, the biggest load here at 13 kVA, three-phase 200 V.
The rail: its cable chain lies in a trough in front of the beam and follows the carriage; MachineMotion 2 (1200 W typical) and the UR10e's control box (350 W typical) stand at its end.
All of it: one overhead route, drops at the machines' backs, nothing on the floor of the cell but the rail's own chain.
